description:
Waqaa (وقاء) is a flood-safety app idea for wadis (dry valleys) in Saudi Arabia. Many people visit wadis for recreation and judge them by old experience, with no easy way to know when conditions around a wadi have changed. Waqaa starts from NASA satellite data: we study how rainfall around a wadi has changed over many years, and test whether the change is real.

Our vision is a dedicated flood app that sends early warnings to citizens, telling them when to stay away from a wadi
